# CodeNexa

> CodeNexa is a Sri Lankan IT and digital marketing agency offering website development, custom software, website maintenance, branding, and social media marketing.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://codenexa.com.lk/services/website-development/): Business websites, online stores, bookings, and website improvements for businesses in Sri Lanka.
- [Brand & Identity](https://codenexa.com.lk/services/brand-identity/): Logo design, colour palettes, typography and brand guidelines for businesses in Sri Lanka.
- [Social Media](https://codenexa.com.lk/services/social-media-marketing/): Social media management, post design, video editing, AI video production and Facebook advertising for Sri Lankan businesses.
- [Custom Software Development](https://codenexa.com.lk/services/custom-software-development/): Custom software development for bookings, customer portals, dashboards, internal tools, and system integrations.
- [Website Maintenance](https://codenexa.com.lk/services/website-maintenance/): Monthly website maintenance, troubleshooting, website security, and hosting support for businesses in Sri Lanka.
